R-hierarchy.reason: The cover, trip title, and large '20 days to go' lead the screen, followed by the packing card with its clear 'Packing list' button and the Day 1 plan, so no unrelated elements compete equally.

R-fill.reason: The packing card in primaryContainer, together with its filled button, is the only saturated fill; Day 1 sits on a neutral tonal container and the itinerary rows on the surface.

R-surfaces.reason: Calm warm-neutral surfaces form the backdrop, with one accent card for packing and a tonal card for Day 1, which keeps the groups clear.

R-controls.reason: Back, the tonal share icon button, and the filled 'Packing list' button each read as their own tappable control, and there are no floating text-only buttons.

R-font.reason: Big Shoulders Display is used at display and headline size for the title, the '20' countdown, and the '18' count, and its extreme condensed width gives a deliberate trail-signage voice; body text stays Google Sans Flex and the data uses Google Sans Code.

R-platform.reason: The screen follows Android conventions: a back arrow, a share action icon, no disclosure chevrons, and no Cancel/Done text.

R-text.reason: No text is clipped or overlapping in any render; the foldable's partly visible itinerary row sits at a scrolling edge, which is expected.

R-dark.reason: In dark, all text, icons, the wavy progress, and the light-on-dark button are clearly legible against their surfaces.

R-adaptive.reason: The foldable places packing and Day 1 side by side, and the tablet and desktop add a dedicated itinerary pane beside the cover and Day 1 plan, revealing content the phone only reaches by scrolling.

R-idea.reason: The 'altitude ledger' idea, with a bar per itinerary day scaled to the 5,364 m peak and monospaced altitudes, is specific to a high-altitude trek.

R-semantics.reason: The 'Itinerary', 'Packing', and 'Day 1' titles all carry semantics { heading() }, and there are no toggling rows.

R-fields.reason: The proposal has no text fields.

R-visibility.reason: Nothing is shown and hidden, and no alpha is used to hide content.

R-blur.reason: No blur is used, and no text is drawn over the photo.

R-trek-forms.reason: Packing is a progress card with a wavy indicator, Day 1 is a timeline with time stamps and stats, and the itinerary is a segmented list with altitude bars, so each kind of information has its own form; no text sits on the photo.
